question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the two coupled Kerr parametric oscillators (two cat qubits or a two-spin annealer) carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Goto, Sci. Rep. 6, 21686 (2016); Puri et al., Nat. Commun. 8, 15785 (2017)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: two coupled Kerr parametric oscillators (two cat qubits or a two-spin annealer)
closure: loss kappa = 1 into a zero-temperature bath; the vacuum noise of the loss enters as D = kappa/8 per quadrature (truncated Wigner)
observable: signs of x1 and x2 (Ising configuration)
